Hi Susan / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call last week. Per our discussion, Atlas Health is moving forward with: 1) a renewal of the Redwood subscription with term change from 12 -> 24 months, and 2) a committed capacity increase of +2 dedicated units (anticipated go-live: Mar 15).

To keep timelines tight, can you confirm the exact procurement portal path and which vendor onboarding documents Atlas needs refreshed? We attached the latest Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf and Capacity_Pricing.xlsx for reference. Specific asks from our side:
- Confirm PO creation steps in your portal (required fields, approver emails).
- Any updated vendor forms (W-9/bank details) or a vendor profile refresh required for this renewal?
- Who completes/receives security artifacts (SOC 2/attestation) during the vendor onboarding refresh?

Deal details: RDW-3247 (HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3247). Our CS/Finance teams are prepped to act once we have portal instructions.

Next steps I propose: you share the procurement portal link and list of required docs; we upload the W-9 and amended SOW; Redwood provides SOC2 attestation and any requested security evidence. If DocuSign is preferred for the amendment, we can route that as well.

Thanks — cc'ing Sean and Karthik to help with compliance and pricing approvals.

Best,

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear summary.

You should use our vendor portal to start the onboarding refresh: https://atlashealth.procureportal.com/vendor-onboarding/rdw. The key items we need from you to start the PO flow are:
- Updated W-9 (PDF) and vendor banking details (uploaded securely in portal)
- Signed renewal amendment or SOW (PDF)
- SOC 2 attestation (we accept the PDF attestation or a secure link to the report)
- Procurement checklist items (I attached the Procurement_Checklist_Atlas.pdf)

Portal notes: once you upload documents, our procurement system creates a request and notifies the approvers. Please complete the vendor profile (tax ID, address, remittance info). If you prefer, we can accept a DocuSign for the amendment and then capture the DocuSign envelope id in our portal.

Vendor onboarding refresh items that often delay processing: missing tax information, mismatched legal name on W-9, or missing SOC2 evidence. For security artifacts, route them to security_ops@atlashealth.com — they will confirm sufficiency and next steps.

Let me know once you upload and I will expedite the PO creation.

Best,
Susan Lloyd
Sr. Vendor Manager — Atlas Health
susan.lloyd@atlashealth.com
